remote_attendance: The meeting is called to order at 3:00 PM.

content.string: That it BE NOTED that no pecuniary interests were disclosed.

motion_texts.string:
That, on the recommendation of the Managing Director, Corporate Services and City Treasurer, Chief Financial Officer, the following actions be taken:



a)        the issuance of serial debentures for a total of $49,380,000 BE APPROVED; it being noted the average all-in rate is 2.655% over a 10-year term; and



b)        the proposed by-law appended to the staff report dated March 25, 2019 BE INTRODUCED at the Municipal Council meeting on March 26, 2019, to authorize the borrowing upon serial debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $49,380,000 towards the cost of certain capital works of The Corporation of the City of London;



it being noted that the Corporate Services Committee received the attached presentation from M. Khan and K. Martin (RBC), with respect to this matter.

2.title: Court Security and Prisoner Transportation Program Transfer Payment Agreement

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the Managing Director, Corporate Services and City Treasurer, Chief Financial Officer, the proposed by-law appended to the staff report dated March 25, 2019 as Appendix “A” BE INTRODUCED at the Municipal Council meeting on March 26, 2019 to approve the Ontario Transfer Payment Agreement for the Court Security and Prisoner Transportation Program with Her Majesty the Queen in right of Ontario as represented by the Minister of Community Safety and Correctional Services and The Corporation of the City of London; and to authorize the Mayor and the City Clerk to execute the Agreement.
